claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Acris positions itself as a command bar for AI agents.
claims.quote: The command bar for AI agents

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Acris provides a task manager for both users and agents and says tasks and projects can be managed in one place without switching between tools.
claims.quote: A task manager for you and your agents. Manage your projects and task in one place without switching between tools

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: In a sample interaction, the agent asks the user to make two decisions before it drafts campaign briefs.
claims.quote: Before I draft the campaign briefs, two calls are yours to make.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: In a sample interaction, the agent reports that paid social drove volume but blended CAC climbed to $84, while content and lifecycle delivered best ROAS 4.2x at a third of the spend.
claims.quote: Q2 takeaways: paid social drove volume but**blended CAC climbed to $84** while content + lifecycle quietly delivered our best`ROAS 4.2x` at a third of the spend.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Acris says it quietly harvests people, preferences, and decisions into a living memory graph, and every agent reads from and writes to the same memory.
claims.quote: Acris quietly harvests what matters — people, preferences, decisions — into a living graph. Every agent reads from the same memory and writes new learnings back, so each run starts already in the loop

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: Acris says tasks, sessions, and memory organize around the project the user is working in.
claims.quote: Tasks, sessions, and memory all organize around the project you're working in
